description: One answer streamed a word at a time. It stops after its first ten words until copilot-reconnect-journey.spec.ts, which follows it, has cut the connection and released the run, then streams the rest over about three seconds.
title: Slow answer

turns.text: Here is a long answer that arrives slowly, one word at a time, so that you can drop the connection halfway through and check that every word still reaches the chat exactly once after the connection comes back.
